changes_vs_C63: whole lifecycle reference branch; C63 remains immutable baseline; no automatic incumbent replacement

global.entry_budget: one existing fixed reference notional, shared across all entry legs

time.signal: complete UTC daily candles built from six complete canonical 4h bars
time.execution: existing observed 4h OHLC engine with causal pending orders
time.failed_progress_clock: first observed 4h close at or after first_fill_ts + 72h; exactly once
time.trailing_clock: three most recent COMPLETE UTC daily bars, never current unfinished day

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: reuse the existing canonical non-proprietary squeeze predicate on completed DAILY bars; do not import C63 eligibility/ER/range rescue/native momentum exit
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: substitute; do not call it identical Squeeze Pro

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: require a rolling 365-complete-day high event in prior 20 completed days. For a younger listing use all-time high only when full since-listing history is actually covered and listing origin is verified; otherwise mark that symbol/date ineligible
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: 365 calendar days / recency20 are disclosed crypto definitions

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: use strict radius2 confirmed DAILY extrema. At decision time take the latest alternating high A, low B, high C, low D. Require B<A; 0.9*A<=C<=1.1*A; B<D<C. C is a recovered rim and D a higher handle low. No future-confirmed pivot may be used
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: coarse geometry proxy, NOT Carter quantitative pattern

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: after geometry exists, require three consecutive complete daily squeeze observations and close>EMA21. Freeze H=C, L=D, EMA8/21 and ATR21 from the setup close. Require 0<L<H and valid finite positive ATR. Orders start only in the next observed 4h bar

prepare fixed levels EMA8 (30% notional), EMA21 (40%), L+0.618*(H-L) breakout (remaining budget). Never exceed 100% reference notional. A breakout fills all still-unfilled allocation and cancels limits. If limits fill first, breakout fills only remainder. Fills use the existing engine with explicit gap/ambiguity handling; a historical signal cannot force a past fill
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: one causal implementation of allocation example

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: before first fill, cancel on completed daily close below L or at 20 complete daily bars after setup. Cancel all pending adds at any protective exit, failed-progress exit or first profit realization. One campaign per frozen setup; rearm only after a later new confirmed handle D and a newly qualified daily setup
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: expiry/rearm are new fixed implementation choices, not source rules

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: freeze ATR21 at setup. Initial stop first_fill_price-2*ATR21. After an add, candidate global stop=max(old_stop, actual weighted_entry-2*ATR21); never widen. Refuse nonpositive stops/invalid risk geometry before entry. No account5% allocation and no DCA outside the prepared notional budget
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: average-entry and add handling are disclosed

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: at the 72h checkpoint, realized plus hypothetically closed remaining position minus all modeled accrued/candidate exit costs <=0 triggers remainder liquidation next observed open; do not reset clock on adds
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: UTC72h and cost-aware <=0 resolve source trading-day/wording ambiguity

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: targets H-one native price increment; L+1.272*(H-L); L+1.618*(H-L). First profit event freezes assembled position quantity and cancels unfilled entry legs. Exit one third of that quantity at each first two levels, remainder at last level or protective stop. If setup/next gap is already beyond the first target, skip as an explicit no-chase implementation choice
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: fixed anchors, tick amount and campaign rounding are disclosed

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: after confirmed first profit fill, next-bar stop=max(old, weighted_entry-ATR21); after second=max(old,weighted_entry). In final runner stage, ratchet to max(old, min(low of last3 complete daily bars)-increment) effective only after observation. Never apply a later ratchet retrospectively within the bar
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: update timing is disclosed; risk only tightens

disclosed_operational_choices.choice: reuse existing tested gap-aware conditional-order primitives. For ambiguous OHLC sequences take a documented conservative feasible order, record ambiguity count/notional and do not call it reconstructed tick execution. Do not skip ambiguous losers. Never assume a newly armed order existed before its decision
retain native open/pending/censor bookkeeping and modeled terminal mark including remaining exit costs. Do not force a profitable close, omit unfinished trades or restore time20/40
disclosed_operational_choices.source_status: research accounting, not trader discretionary exit

implementation_discretion: Work may resolve API/schema/numerical conventions from existing code before freeze, with an explicit changelog. It may not optimize these choices on market outcome, silently omit a core source stage, add another economic variant, or change thresholds after first result.

data_budget.warmup_purpose: pre-evaluation historical daily context only; same existing venue/symbols, <=370 days preceding each start; retain original evaluation OHLC unchanged

comparison: C63 original; C68 previous partial-entry adaptation contextual only; JC_LIFECYCLE_CRYPTO_V1. Compare only bound identical calendar/price/cost semantics. R/B20/F failures remain saved, not reactivated.
numeric_defaults_are: frozen research assumptions, not SSOT/live thresholds and not claimed optimal
